notes:
Lead came in via self-serve signup; small ecommerce platform (SaaS storefronts plugin). Interested primarily in Redwood Hosted API for quick integration. Main ask: simple, copy-paste examples that wire Redwood hosted endpoints into LangChain and LlamaIndex flows and a Vercel AI SDK edge example. They said: 'we need something our frontend team can drop into a Next.js app — minimal infra overhead.'

Key points from intro call:
- Signup via trial credits, tested basic prompt completions.
- Wants embeddings + vector search for product doc search (LlamaIndex style).
- Wants LangChain agent orchestration for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and a simple memory store example.
- Frontend is Vercel (Next.js). Asking for an edge-friendly example using Vercel AI SDK + Redwood hosted API (streaming desirable).
- Prefers public cloud deployment only (no VPC/on-prem).
- Model preferences: low-cost open models initially (quantized), but open to Redwood-verified mid-size models for latency/quality tradeoffs.
- Latency/throughput targets: interactive chat <300-500ms for single-turn short responses, batch embedding throughput ~50 reqs/s in POC. Cost sensitivity high — want guidance on batching, KV/prefix caching, and quantization recommendations.
- Security: needs SSO (SAML) to control access to team account, audit logs for requests, and clear retention policies. Data residency: prefers NA region.
- Quote from lead: 'If you give us a plug-and-play LangChain + Vercel tutorial we can onboard frontend and backend in a week.'

Also added as action items: produce a 1-file example (Next.js API route) + a small Node LangChain script that shows embedding ingestion into a vector DB (they're evaluating Pinecone), and an example of swapping in Redwood-hosted embedding model with minimal code change.
